title: Hide completed items from the list and add due dates

notes.body: **[1/4]** New module. Due dates come in as `YYYY-MM-DD` strings and live as UTC dates so a local time zone cannot shift the day.

**[2/4]** Strict format. Anything but `YYYY-MM-DD` throws, so a bad date fails at `add`, not when the list prints.

Silently accepting `Date.parse` output would let `2026-1-5` through as a local-time date.
**[3/4]** `list` becomes `open` and hides completed items. `all` keeps the old behaviour for callers that want everything.

comments.body: This compares strings. `dates.mjs` already has `isPast`; use it here and drop the slicing.
Should `formatList` take the items as an argument instead of reaching into the store? Then `all()` callers can format too.
Why is a done item never overdue? A late completion still counts as late for a report.
